body: internal/processor/archetype_provider.go: ArchetypeProvider implements Provider using POST archetype-engine/invoke. intentForSource() maps SEC form types to spirit stacks per NORTHSTAR (8-K→Aim#23+Eligos#15 fraud detection, 10-K→Eligos+Vassago+Marax systematic mastery, SC13D→Bune+Aim, DEF14A→Orobas+Botis, PR→Forneus+Vassago). parseSignalFromText() extracts JSON Signal from synthesized output.
